subject: Interruption 7/19 — request for remediation credits & trial extension
messages:
From: Erik Holm <erik.holm@cobalt.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interruption this morning — errors and timeouts (7/19)

Ben —

We saw a burst of 500s and timeouts between 08:10–08:55 PT this morning that affected our ingestion pipeline. Our calls started failing with 502/504 and retries pushed our token usage up; this is impacting a PoC we're running with a live customer. Can you confirm root cause and whether Redwood will provide remediation credits?

Incident window: 2025-07-19 08:10–08:55 PT
Approx tokens impacted: ~120k (from our logs)
Impact: several batch jobs failed, customer-facing latency spikes, and one job timed out entirely.

We'd like a remedial credit applied to the account and a 30-day trial extension while we finish the PoC. I can attach logs if helpful.

—Erik
Erik Holm
Head of Integrations, Cobalt AI
Erik.Holm@cobalt.ai
Attachments: incident-scrub.log (text)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Erik Holm <erik.holm@cobalt.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interruption this morning — errors and timeouts (7/19)

Hi Erik — thanks for the heads up and the details, really sorry for the disruption. We're pulling the platform logs now and Jonas is already looking at the serving layer traces.

Quick asks so we can triage and scope a remediation: can you confirm the customer account id (your PoC tenant) and attach the token-usage CSV for the morning window? Also whether these were mostly streaming calls or large batch calls — that helps with batching/queueing analysis.

I cc'd Marissa and Jonas so we can move on credits and the incident write-up in parallel. I'll keep you posted with an ETA for a formal reply/offer by end of day.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

From: Erik Holm <erik.holm@cobalt.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interruption this morning — errors and timeouts (7/19)

Thanks Ben.

Customer / PoC tenant: cobalt-poc-17
Call profile: primarily batch ingestion calls (single request, large prompt) with some short streaming requests for diagnostics.
Attached: usage-window.csv with timestamped call counts (morning window) and incident-scrub.log

We estimate ~120k tokens impacted and would like a good-faith remediation (credits) and 30 days back on the trial clock — the timeline is tight for our customer.

Appreciate a formal offer.

—Erik
Attachments: usage-window.csv, incident-scrub.log

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Interruption this morning — credits ask (Cobalt AI)

Team — forwarding logs from Cobalt. High level: 45-minute incident, ~120k impacted tokens, PoC tenant (cobalt-poc-17). Customer is asking for credits + 30-day extension.

Suggested remediation (for discussion):
- 2,000 free credits applied immediately (covers token exposure + goodwill)
- 30-day trial extension on their PoC tenant

Marissa — can you confirm if we want to include a complimentary support review (1-hour architecture call)?
Jonas — any indication this was a transient serving-layer blip vs queued/batching misconfig? If it's on us, engineering will write a short incident note for their team.
Laura — finance approval needed for credits > $X threshold; if you can sign off or counter, I'll communicate to the customer.

Attachments: usage-window.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Interruption this morning — credits ask (Cobalt AI)

Ben / team — reviewed usage and the incident notes. Finance can approve a remediation of 1,500 free credits applied to account cobalt-poc-17 and a 30-day trial extension. That amount aligns with our unit economics for trial relief in PoC situations and keeps the approval within delegated limits.

We should also include the complimentary 60-minute technical review (Marissa to coordinate). I'll create the billing adjustment and provide the internal ref once posted — expect the credit to be applied within 3 business days of confirmation.

Related: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/OPS-4827 (serving trace)
Doc: https://docs.redwood.com/incident/COB-2025-091

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Erik Holm <erik.holm@cobalt.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Offer: account credit + trial extension for cobalt-poc-17

Hi Erik — thanks again for the quick details and for your patience while we reviewed this.

What's approved:
- 1,500 free credits to be applied to account cobalt-poc-17 (will show as a billing adjustment, posted within 3 business days)
- 30-day trial extension from the current expiration date
- Complimentary 60-minute architecture review with our solutions team (Marissa will reach out to schedule)

We believe the root cause was a transient serving-layer overload during the morning burst. Jonas and the infra team are continuing the post-incident analysis and we'll share the short incident summary attached.

Next steps for you: please reply to confirm acceptance and we'll kick off the billing adjustment and schedule the review.

Attachments: Cobalt-incident-summary.pdf

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Erik Holm <erik.holm@cobalt.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer: account credit + trial extension for cobalt-poc-17

Ben — confirmed, we accept the 1,500 credits and the 30-day extension. Please apply and let me know once the adjustment is visible; Marissa can reach out to schedule the review.

Much appreciated — helps keep the PoC on track.

—Erik
